annotations.title: Verify legal citations in a text

description: CHECK A DRAFT BEFORE IT GOES OUT. Paste any text that cites Romanian law — your own draft, a client's contract, an opinion someone else wrote — and every article reference in it, down to the alineat, letter or point, is checked against the corpus. Each reference comes back as one of: ÎN VIGOARE (with the date it was last amended), ABROGAT, ARTICOL INEXISTENT (the act is real but has no such article — a fabricated citation), SUBDIVIZIUNE INEXISTENTĂ (the article is real but not the alineat, letter or point cited), or NEVERIFICAT (could not be checked, which is NOT the same as correct). A mention whose act cannot be read is listed as NEVERIFICAT, not skipped. RUN THIS ON ANY LEGAL TEXT YOU PRODUCE: article numbers move, articles are repealed, and a citation that was right when you learned it may not be right today. Extraction is deterministic — no guessing about which references exist. A POINT of an act is checked too, in the form an accountant cites it: "pct. 87 din OMFP 1802/2014", "art. 25 din Legea contabilității nr. 82/1991". A point that cannot be read comes back NEVERIFICAT, never as missing. An ACCOUNT the text names ("contul 4426", "ct. 401") is shown with the general chart of accounts' own name and function beside the one the text uses, in a section after the references; one it does not find is NEVERIFICAT.

text.description: The text to check. Romanian legal prose citing articles, e.g. 'potrivit art. 1357 din Codul civil ...'. Up to 20000 characters.
